evidence: Runtime fact list (skill quality-checks.md #4) vs public text, all stated: (1) entry path: instruction.md:5 'The finished app goes in /app, starting from /app/server.js'; integration.md:3 'Node 22 running /app/server.js'. (2) start command/user/cwd: integration.md:3 'as an ordinary user and not necessarily from inside /app, so find your own files relative to server.js' - matches test.sh:97-111 (env -i, setpriv uid 65534, may run the /tmp/submission copy). (3) port: integration.md:3 'listen on 0.0.0.0 port 3000' = test.sh PORT=3000 and probe 127.0.0.1:3000 = app_context URL. (4) storage: integration.md:3 'SQLite at /app/app.db, or at the path in DB_PATH when that is set' = test.sh DB_PATH injection; NODE_PATH named too. (5) health: integration.md:3 'GET /api/health should answer 200 even if the database can't be opened' = test.sh probe_ready. (6) fixed clock: integration.md:7 '2026-05-12T11:00:00Z' = seed clock and criteria. (7) seed: instruction.md:5 '/assets/seed_data.json'; integration.md:5 import once into empty DB, restarts keep everything, hand over without a DB, no symlinks (stricter than test.sh:72-83, which allows internal node_modules links - safe direction). (8) accounts: walls-and-retention.md:3-13 password123 and all five emails/roles, matching seed accounts and app_context. Network public: integration.md:3 allows external fonts/CDN; nothing to state. Graded-vs-asked mapping for all 16 functional, 5 polish, 4 visual and 2 gate criteria: client scope/plain not-available (walls L50, instruction L7, integration L9); wall every route + transcript address (walls L50, L68); mentions/links under walls (conversations L17, L21; walls L50); live wall add + Harriet-only control (walls L52); 3-level replies with quotes and parent ordering (conv L5); deleted placeholder + exact 7-day boundary (conv L9, walls L56-58); timer change/off/partner-only/label beside title (walls L56); hold scope/delete-refusal/release/'On hold' typed text (walls L62, conv L9, L13); edits/earlier versions/stale refusal keeping text (conv L9); safe formatting incl. quotes, versions, search snippets, transcripts, http/https only (conv L13); message link preview/'not available' (conv L17); unread per person, same in every tab, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted (conv L25); idempotent resend and stable order of same-time messages (conv L29, integration L7); live updates without disturbing draft/scroll/open thread (conv L31; criterion allows 10 s vs stated 5 s - lenient); case-insensitive search, click opens message, no earlier versions, transcript heading/thread/author/time/hold/versions/no controls (walls L66-68); restart persistence without re-import (integration L5); 390 px phone (conv L33); refusal reason next to action and persistent (walls L70); timer label and hold mark visibility (walls L56, L62). Conforming-alternative probe: an app using a different route scheme, cookie name, sidebar vs top list, or any time format still passes (functional prompt.md:36-37, 56; app_context L27). Weak-app probe: an app that ignores DB_PATH, listens elsewhere, reseeds on restart or hard-codes a cwd-relative path fails, but each of those is a stated requirement, so failure is fair. Observations (not defects): sign-out is used by signin_and_client_scope Part A and polish refusal_in_place but never literally requested - it is implied by instruction.md:7/9 ('Until somebody signs in', 'sign in as different people') and is house-convention identity surface per SKILL.md known false positives; 'following the link opens the matter at that message' is the ordinary meaning of a message link (conv L17, walls L50 'following an old link'); polish transcript_print's visible nesting follows from 'in their threads' (walls L68). PORT/HOME env injected by test.sh are not named, but the port is fixed at 3000 and agrees; that string agreement belongs to the deterministic runtime-contract row. Source-level review only: no runtime or judge run was needed or claimed for this row; it says nothing about Oracle, model or portal scores.
